question.:question/problem:
The row echelon form matrix $A$ is given below. What are its **non**-pivot columns?

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}9 & 0 & -9 \\ 0 & -9 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}
$$

Select all that apply.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Remember that the pivots of a matrix in row echelon form are the first non-zero entries in each row of the matrix.

We can see that $A$ has $2$ pivots in the $1$st and $2$nd columns:

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}9 & 0 & -9 \\ 0 & -9 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}
$$

Therefore, the only non-pivot column is the $3$rd column.
